senses.gloss:
मोघ मोघ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. मुह्),
vain, useless, aimless, fruitless, unprofitable, (अमो-
घातिथि, a guest who does not come causelessly or
uselessly); left, abandoned; idle; (अस्), m. an en-
closure, hedge, fence; (आ), f. the trumpet flower,
Bignonia Suaveolens; a species of plant, the seeds of
which are used as a vermifuge, = विडङ्ग; (अम्), ind.
in vain, uselessly.
—मोघ-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, one
whose actions are fruitless or unavailing, observing
useless ceremonies.
—मोघ-ज्ञान, अस्, आ, अम्, one
whose knowledge is useless or unavailing, cultivating
any but religious wisdom.
—मोघ-ता, f. vainness,
uselessness, aimlessness, erringness, (अ-मोघतया
युतम् अस्त्रम्, a weapon endowed with unerring-
ness, Kirātārj. VI. 40); idleness.
—मोघ-पुष्पा,
f. a barren woman.
—मोघ-हासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, laugh-
ing without any cause or occasion.
—मोघाश
(˚घ-आश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose hopes are vain.
—मोघी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make
vain, render useless, foil, frustrate, baffle, disappoint.
—मोघी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to
become useless or aimless, be foiled.
—मोघी-भूत,
अस्, आ, अम्, become useless, rendered vain, foiled.

मोघोलि, इस्, m. an enclosure, hedge, fence; [cf.
मोघ above.]
